narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate on the landing book-map: a single image that says 'two worlds of life, one shared chemistry' — a human-Na'vi hybrid body asleep in its tank, the quiet proof that Pandoran and Earth life are made of the same stuff.
subject: A human-Na'vi hybrid avatar body, blue-skinned and longer than a man, floating curled and asleep inside a tall cylindrical glass tank filled with faintly glowing amber nutrient fluid; fine feeding and sensor lines trail from its body into the dark, and a single twist of a luminous cyan DNA double helix drifts in the fluid beside it as a quiet visual motif.
scene: A dim laboratory chamber on Pandora at night, the lit tank the only bright object, banks of unlit dark equipment receding into indigo shadow around it.
camera: A reverent three-quarter view looking slightly up at the tank, intimate and still, the curled body framed centrally behind the curved glass.
light: The amber nutrient fluid as a warm interior key glowing from within the tank, a cool cyan rim along the glass and the drifting helix, deep indigo ambient shadow swallowing the room.
palette: Void-indigo room and deep teal shadow dominant; a scarce ember-amber glow from the tank fluid and a thread of Pandora cyan along the helix as the deliberate warm-and-key accents.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted texture, observed-from-life confidence.
detail_level: Crisp on the curled body and the curved glass meniscus; equipment and room dissolving into dark haze.
composition: The lit tank centred with the body curled within it, generous dark negative space around, the drifting helix a small bright note to one side.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette with a single warm interior light source (the tank); the still, clinical-yet-wondrous mood that anchors the whole chapter.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
